findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bazaar_category_heat_feed, extract_json, fetch_x402_content, web_search, chat_completion, reprice_regret, research_answer, run_python, tweets_search, x402_endpoint_verify · Private data: crypto_price, wallet_spy, agent_preflight_bundle, browser_evidence, base_transfer_search_rpc, base_usdc_balance, base_wallet_profile, gleif_resolve, payer_profile, people_record_normalize, base_transfer_search, prepaid_access_token, people_search, profile_search, run_python, x402_receipt_lookup, route_task, wallet_analyze, token_metrics, solana_ops_context, token_flow_activity · Public sink: bazaar_category_heat, bazaar_price_stats, prepaid_access_token, reprice_regret, run_python, award_flight_search, tweets_search · Destructive: batch_url_json, browser_evidence, web_search, run_python, solana_ops_context.
